description: This PHP script handles the editing of banners in the Revive Adserver platform, including form generation, validation, file uploads, permission enforcement, and database interactions for creating or updating banner records.

classes.name: OA_Admin_Template
classes.description: Template class used for rendering HTML pages in the admin interface.

classes.name: OA_Admin_UI_Component_Form
classes.description: Form class used for building and managing banner edit forms.

classes.name: OA_Creative_File
classes.description: Handles file uploads and content type detection for banner creatives.

methods.name: bannerEditProcessForm
methods.description: Processes submitted banner form data, updates or inserts banner records, manages file uploads, and redirects.

methods.name: displayBannerEditPage
methods.description: Displays the banner editing page with form and navigation, handles SSL safety warning.

methods.name: addUploadGroup
methods.description: Adds upload controls to the form for banner images.

methods.name: buildBannerForm
methods.description: Constructs the banner editing form with fields based on banner type.

methods.name: checkForErrorFileUploaded
methods.description: Checks for errors in uploaded files and displays error message if any.

methods.name: _getContentTypeIconImageName
methods.description: Returns icon filename based on content type.

methods.name: _getPrettySize
methods.description: Converts size in bytes to a human-readable string.

methods.name: _getBannerSizeText
methods.description: Returns formatted size text for a banner file.

methods.name: _checkBannerSslSafety
methods.description: Checks if banner's image URL is SSL safe.
